typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 4 / transferLabel.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 4 / footer.

recognitionRules: Retain the notebook margin and top rule as a stable writing frame.
Pair Optima instructions with Noteworthy annotations only where a handwritten cue adds meaning.
Place a worked example before the guided attempt, with response lines close to each prompt.
Use muted green and earth tones without tinting every writing area.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Try a first version. Compare it with the example. Change one thing.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use FIELD NOTES in Optima with PRACTICE below and a short margin rule to the left. No illustrated notebook icon is needed.
invariants: Retain the notebook margin and top rule as a stable writing frame.
Pair Optima instructions with Noteworthy annotations only where a handwritten cue adds meaning.
Place a worked example before the guided attempt, with response lines close to each prompt.
adaptations: A single activity sheet retains the example, attempt and reflection sequence.
Increase writing space rather than compressing prompts for print.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Noteworthy is an Apple/system font; not bundled.
Optima is an Apple/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
